_comment: Findings the First Officer may bring back from the exterior walkaround (Settings → Voice First Officer → Ground Crew → Walkaround). Each: id (unique), spoken (what the FO says after 'Walkaround complete, captain.'), severity cosmetic|deferrable|noGo, techLogTitle + techLogCategory (A|B|C|D) for the tech-log item (deferrable: the captain is asked; noGo: raised regardless — only drawn when allowNoGo is on), conditions (any of icing, precipitation, night, afterLanding — all listed must hold), weight (relative draw weight), deice: true for a finding that leads into the de-icing question instead of a tech-log item. At most one finding per walkaround, with the configured chance. Edits are picked up live.

findings.spoken: One thing — the number two main tyre is wearing close to the limit, cords not showing yet.
findings.techLogTitle: No. 2 main wheel tyre worn near limit

findings.spoken: There's a slight hydraulic weep on the left main strut, nothing dripping.
findings.techLogTitle: Hydraulic weep, left main landing gear strut

findings.spoken: We're missing a static wick on the right elevator.
The right navigation light is unserviceable — the lens is cracked.
The aft cargo door seal is frayed along the bottom edge.
There's bird strike evidence on the number one nacelle lip — no damage I can see, but worth a look by engineering.
findings.techLogTitle: Bird strike evidence, engine 1 inlet — inspection required

findings.spoken: The number three brake wear pin is right down at the limit.
findings.techLogTitle: No. 3 brake wear indicator at limit

findings.spoken: The nose gear taxi light isn't working.
There's ice on the wing upper surface, both sides — we'll need de-icing.
The captain's pitot cover was still on — I've pulled it, it's in the flight deck now.
The refuel panel door wasn't latched — it's closed and latched now.
A fresh oil streak under the number two nacelle — looks like a weeping drain, I've noted it.
findings.techLogTitle: Oil streak, engine 2 nacelle drain — leak check required

findings.spoken: The wings are wet but clean, nothing adhering.
We've got a steady hydraulic drip from the green system at the right main — that one's a no-go for me, I'm raising it.
findings.techLogTitle: Hydraulic leak, green system, right main landing gear bay

findings.spoken: The number one main tyre has cords showing — that's a no-go, I'm raising it.
findings.techLogTitle: No. 1 main wheel tyre worn beyond limit (cords visible)
